events.title: Pro-Palestinian locals attack supporters of Israeli football team Maccabi Tel Aviv F.C. after a match with 아약스 in Amsterdam , Netherlands , following instances of anti-Palestinian and anti-Arab chants and vandalism by Maccabi ultras . At least 30 people are injured, with five hospitalized, and 62 people are arrested.
